notes: The recruitment's opening on black: a grey haze gathers (frames 2-7) as the company's logo is lit gold from the left (2-7) and a line of light shoots across it (4-5) with six dark rarity emblems on it; a curtain of light floods the picture (8-48) -- green on the left and sea blue on the right, a white flash (22-26), yellow under olive, then gold under a darkening top -- the line drawing back off to the right (13-15) and the logo showing through in white, flaring again on 35; the picture cuts to black on 49 with the logo in grey, the emblems light white one by one from the left (43-62), the logo fades (61-67) and the emblems blink out (65-67).

Measured on the reference (display values) and written in the picture's units (half its height = 1).  The logo is the reference's own (Drawings/Logo.json, traced by calibration/trace_drawing.py with Logo.trace.json); grey on black its ink is white at 0.28, the lettering at 0.86 of that; over the curtain it is the same ink at the opacity keyed frame by frame, read against the contour lines cut out of it, which show the curtain bare.  The gold sweep is fitted on frames 2-7: yellow ink at three quarters of the logo's tone (the lettering a third stronger), a soft front 250 px wide slowing to a stop three fifths of the way across, the light fading over 314 px behind it.

The line: a white core 17 px thick in a yellow halo fading over some 7 px, 8 px below the middle, its ends curling up by 28 px at the picture's edges (falling to 1/e within 75 px); its head crosses on frames 4-5 and its tail follows, gathering speed, over 13-15.

The emblems are 83.3 px apart about x 950, y 547.  Dark, they are black at the opacity keyed (their faces against what lies behind them), opaque from 40; white, each lights in the reference's own flickering steps, all go out on 65, back on 66 at three quarters and out on 67.

The curtain is twelve bands read off the reference on every frame from 8 to 48 (calibration/fit_curtain.py with Intro.curtain.json): each band's head and foot colour (a channel the picture clips brought up by the band's contrast), the contrast of its head and foot, and where and how softly its colour turns from the one to the other.  With the haze under it, it is the picture the titles are laid over (underlays); the titles are four layers laid one over another in display space as the reference's are: the logo, the line, the dark emblems, the white emblems.
